query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as unmatched_students
FROM students s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM dojos d
  WHERE s.venue = d.name 
    AND s.scheduleDay = d.schedule_day 
    AND s.scheduleTime = d.schedule_time
);
